abilities.name: Wind Realm of Nasamjnin
_curatorNotes: behavior changed from 'stance' to 'instant' per recipe — Manifest Gale is a character status (not a stance that replaces N/charge attacks).

Manifest Gale state: AddStatus(skillKey, 1080f=18s). Not modeled as a summon — it is a character status that enables Hurricane Arrow (next fully-charged shot becomes Hurricane Arrow dealing Pressurized Collapse). At C1, up to 2 Hurricane Arrows can be fired per cast. Reviewer to decide representation (state window / buff duration field).

cooldownStartDelay: 12 — SetCD(360f) is called inside a 12-frame-delayed task in skill.go. Effects[] empty — initial polyhedron hit (AoE Anemo DMG) and Hurricane Arrow DMG not authored; needs reviewer pass.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Not modeled: the Manifest Gale state — charged shots are drawn with Hurricane Arrow timing whether or not it's active, and the Pressurized Collapse vortex never appears on the timeline."
abilities.description:
Faruzan deploys a polyhedron that deals AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. She will also enter the Manifest Gale state.
While in the Manifest Gale state, Faruzan's next fully charged shot will consume this state and will become a Hurricane Arrow that contains high-pressure currents. This arrow deals Anemo DMG based on the DMG of a fully charged Aimed Shot from "Normal Attack: Parthian Shot."

Pressurized Collapse
The Hurricane Arrow will apply a Pressurized Collapse effect to the opponent or character hit. This effect will be removed after a short delay, creating a vortex that deals AoE Anemo DMG and pulls nearby objects and opponents in. If the Hurricane Arrow does not hit any opponent or character, it will create a Pressurized Collapse effect at its point of impact.
The vortex DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
abilities.caveat: Charged shots are drawn with Hurricane Arrow timing whether or not the Manifest Gale state is active.

abilities.name: The Wind's Secret Ways
_curatorNotes: spawnsAt: 54 (=burstHitmark, the initial AoE hit + shred application). Buff application (Prayerful Wind's Benefit loop) starts at frame 43 (buffFunc at 43+0); Whirlwind Pulse loop fires at 43+137=180. Using burstHitmark as canonical spawn moment. Reviewer to verify.

Effects authored 2026-07-12: Perfidious Wind's Bale (Anemo RES -30%, fixed across talent levels per burst table) and Prayerful Wind's Benefit (Anemo DMG Bonus 32.4% at talent lvl 10, burst table row 'Anemo DMG Bonus'; applies to all party members incl. off-field per KQM TCL). Both are re-applied by each Whirlwind Pulse (~every 2s, 4s per application) for the polyhedron's 12s lifetime — authored as a single 12s onCast window matching the C6 effect's precedent. Approximation: the final pulse's ~4s tail past polyhedron expiry is not modeled; C2's +6s polyhedron extension extends effective buff/shred coverage to ~18s but Effect.duration has no modifier field — not modeled.
Prayerful Wind's Benefit is dynamic (does not snapshot Faruzan's stats; KQM TCL) → snapshottable: false.
Burst duration: 745 frames (base) + 360 frames at C2. 745/60=12.42s rounded to 12s (in-game description). C2 adds 6s → 18s total at C2.

↻ THE BUFF AND SHRED WINDOWS ARE 16s / 22s, NOT 12 / 18 — 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche), ⚓ Nate's call 2026-09-15 ("buffs re-applied per tick are authored at their HONEST length", the Bennett precedent). gcsim `faruzan/burst.go` never grants a 12s statmod: `buffFunc` re-applies a 240-frame Anemo DMG Bonus at 43 + every 239f through 43 + duration (745f, 1105f at C2), with a last refresh AT 43 + duration, so the bonus runs to 1028f from the cast (1388f at C2). The shred is the same shape — the initial hit at 54 and a Whirlwind Pulse at 43 + 137 + 120k, each a 240f ResistMod — and runs to 1020f (1380f). From this window's own anchor (the 54f spawn) that is 16.2s / 16.1s at C0 and 22.2s / 22.1s at C2. Ours ran 12/18, ~4.2s SHORT at every constellation, on the two bars that are Faruzan's entire on-screen content. ⚠️ The SUMMON's `duration` stays 12 (+6 at C2): the polyhedron really does expire there, and only its buff outlives it. The 2026-07-12 note ("the final pulse's ~4s tail … is not modeled") and the [A7b] note's 12s-vs-18s pairing describe the BEFORE.

[A7b] C2 effect durations AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (Nate implement-first): shred + buff each split into a 12s not-C2 / 18s C2-gated pair matching the summon's durationModifiers (+6 at C2) — Effect has no durationModifiers field, so condition-gated duplicates are the wired expression. Buff/shred coverage now tracks the polyhedron at both C0 and C2; the planned A7b caveat (12s-vs-18s contradiction) became unnecessary. Residual approximation, deliberate: buffs are pulse-granted in game (re-applied per Whirlwind Pulse, 4s each) but drawn as one continuous window — same class as other onCast simplifications.

⛔ ORACLE ARTEFACT, 2026-09-17: `gcsim-frames-diff.md` reports this map's `C 61→71`. For a BOW our `C` key is the aimed shot (`peekActionKey` sends `A` to it too) and gcsim's is `ActionAim` = 61 (burst.go); the dumper maps our `C` to `ActionCharge`, which on a bow is only the InitAbilSlice(71) default. `C: 61` is right — ⛔ never migrate it to 71.

C6 PRESSURIZED COLLAPSE AUTHORED 2026-09-20 (docs/summon-tick-gaps-round.md §2 F1) as a cast-hosted `onHit` damage proc. gcsim faruzan/cons.go `c6Collapse`: an OnEnemyDamage hook — non-zero damage, dealt by the ACTIVE character, while that character carries `faruzan-q-dmg-bonus` — adds a 180f status and calls `pressurizedCollapse`, which queues the vortex 33f later (skill.go `vortexHitmark`): Anemo, Durability 25, ICDTagNone. So `procCooldown: 3` (the kit's own "once every 3s"; ⚠️ gcsim's doc comment says 2.5s and its code says 180), `application[0].frame: 33`, `icdGate: 'none'`. `armedFor: 23.1` is the BUFF's life measured from the cast — buffFunc runs 43f → 43 + 1105f with a 240f statmod, so the bonus stands to 1388f, and C6 implies C2. ⚓ Hosted on the CAST rather than on the Dazzling Polyhedron on purpose: the gate is the buff, which outlives the polyhedron by ~4s, and the vortex is Faruzan's constellation, not the polyhedron hitting — the Fischl-A4 / Tri-Karma precedent, so no mark is drawn on the summon's lane. ⚠️ `source: 'active'` refuses an entity-delivered hit where gcsim accepts any attack whose ActorIndex is the active character, so an on-field character's own summon tick does not fire it here. `scaling: 194.4` is the skill table's 'Pressurized Collapse Vortex DMG' at talent level 10 (sidecar row 2; gcsim `vortexDmg[9]`) — the vortex scales on the SKILL's level though the burst hosts it. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-20 (`Bennett E > Fischl E > Faruzan Q > Xiao E N3×16`, C0 vs C6): Faruzan's applications 1 → 8 on a ~215f cadence, her swirls 1 → 3. The FIRST Collapse is fired by Faruzan's own burst — right, gcsim's burst hit at 54f lands with the 43f buff already up — but lands at cast + 33f where gcsim has 54 + 33 = 87f, because a cast's hit record sits at the CAST instant, not its hitmark. Engine-wide, not this effect's to fix.
abilities.description:
Faruzan deploys a Dazzling Polyhedron that unleashes a Whirlwind Pulse and deals AoE Anemo DMG.
While the Dazzling Polyhedron persists, it will continuously move along a triangular path. Once it reaches each corner of that triangular path, it will unleash 1 more Whirlwind Pulse.

Whirlwind Pulse
·When the Whirlwind Pulse is unleashed, it will apply Perfidious Wind's Bale to nearby opponents, decreasing their Anemo RES.
·The Whirlwind Pulse will also apply Prayerful Wind's Benefit to all nearby party members when it is unleashed, granting them an Anemo DMG Bonus.

_curatorNotes: A1's Perfidious Wind's Bale application via the Pressurized Collapse vortex (Hurricane Arrow CA chain, no burst required) is team-facing but not modeled — the Hurricane Arrow → vortex chain isn't authored (E effects[] empty; CA flow is personal-damage territory). The burst-sourced shred is authored on the burst.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The missing debuff bar in a burstless rotation. The −30% Anemo RES shred is authored only on the burst's onCast, so `Faruzan E C` — the A1 route the passive exists to enable — draws no shred bar anywhere, while `Faruzan Q` draws a 12s one. Weaker than the C6 and skill entries because most rotations do cast Q; if Nate wants the column shorter, this is the first of my keeps to reconsider. Category: expected-but-absent.
passives.description: When Faruzan is in the Manifest Gale state created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, the amount of time taken to charge a shot is decreased by 60%, and she can apply The Wind's Secret Ways' Perfidious Wind's Bale to opponents who are hit by the vortex created by Pressurized Collapse.

passives.name: Lost Wisdom of the Seven Caverns
_curatorNotes: Trigger migrated from generator 'manual' to onHit(source:team, element:anemo) + procCooldown 0.8 (2026-07-12). In gcsim this is an OnEnemyHit subscription: when a character affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit deals Anemo DMG (normal/charged/plunge/skill/burst), FlatDmg += 0.32 * Faruzan.BaseATK. 0.8s ICD (48 frames). Hurricane Guard is dynamic (Base ATK read at proc time; KQM TCL).

Gate not expressible: the proc only fires while the hitting character carries Prayerful Wind's Benefit (burst buff active) — no 'while affected by buff X' condition exists, so the effect over-fires outside burst windows. onHit dispatch for damage effects is also not yet computed by the planner (in-progress trigger work), so this currently documents mechanics rather than rendering.

Semantics caveat: in-game this is a FlatDmg addition to the triggering hit, not a separate damage instance; a 'damage' effect is the closest schema shape (no element-filtered all-class flat-DMG buff stat exists).
passives.description: When characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit deal Anemo DMG using Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts to opponents, they will gain the Hurricane Guard effect: This DMG will be increased based on 32% of Faruzan's Base ATK. 1 instance of Hurricane Guard can occur once every 0.8s. This DMG Bonus will be cleared after Prayerful Wind's Benefit expires or after the effect is triggered once.

constellations.name: The Wondrous Path of Truth
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst 2026-05-09 (F1). Target corrected from 'self' to 'team' — c6Buff iterates all chars. ↻ Duration 22s (2026-09-17, T1): `c6Buff` is applied inside the burst's `buffFunc` with the same 240f life, so it runs exactly as long as the Anemo DMG Bonus — 22s from the spawn, since C6 implies C2. The old 12 only drew right because it pooled into the burst's window.

G dependency: gcsim filters the +40% CD to Anemo DMG only (element-conditional). The current authoring renders as a generic +40% CD during the burst, which over-credits non-Anemo hits — sub-ability/element filter (G) needed for fidelity.

C6 also triggers a Pressurized Collapse every 3s (ICD=180 frames) when the active character deals DMG while under Prayerful Wind's Benefit. This proc mechanic is not modeled in effects[]; needs the active-char-hit trigger primitive. ↻ 2026-09-20: AUTHORED — that primitive exists (`onHit`, `source: 'active'`, sim/procs.ts) and the proc lives on the BURST's effects, gated on C6, because a cast-hosted proc is armed by its host cast. See the burst's note.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "The CRIT DMG buff is shown as if it boosts all DMG; in game it only applies to Anemo DMG. Not modeled: the extra Pressurized Collapse triggered by the active character's hits."

When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.
